posts.t: 9 goals on 17 shots this season for Artturi Lehkonen. That goal went off a Lightning player's skate. Hockey gods on his side early on.

Final- Lightning 6, Golden Knights 2

The chances felt fairly even tonight, with both teams creating plenty. 

Andrei Vasilevskiy was the difference. He was brilliant, as he often is.

Brutal turnover by Eichel, and Cirelli buries it top shelf before you can blink. 

4-2 Lightning
